questions: Should the train/test split ratio be fixed at 0.2 (20% test), or is it allowed to vary?
Is the random_state parameter for train_test_split required to be set to the same random_seed as used for data generation?
Should the MSE be computed on the test set only, as implied, or could it be computed on the training set or entire dataset?
Are there any constraints on the range or distribution of the generated features (e.g., standard scaling) beyond what make_regression defaults provide?
Is the linear regression model required to fit with default parameters (e.g., fit_intercept=True) or can it be customized?
Should the function handle invalid inputs like n_samples < n_features, or negative values, and if so, how?
Is the noise level fixed at 0.1 for all calls, or should it be a parameter that can be overridden?
Should the output predictions be returned as a 1D array or 2D column vector?
